reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports the premise that nanoscale trenches can reduce TBR via increased contact area in a GaN/diamond system, but it provides no evidence for the other key premises: the mechanism of enhanced phonon coupling, the transferability to HEA interfaces under fusion-relevant high temperatures and irradiation, or the preservation of structural integrity. The hypothesis relies heavily on unsupported extrapolation.
premises: Nanoscale trenches/corrugations reduce thermal boundary resistance (TBR) by increasing contact area.
The TBR reduction mechanism is enhanced phonon coupling across the interface.
The approach is transferable from GaN/diamond to HEA/metal interfaces under fusion conditions.
Nanopatterning does not compromise the structural integrity (strength, ductility) of the HEA.
